frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The value premium (high book-to-market / low-multiple stocks outperform glamour stocks) reflects expectational error: investors extrapolate past growth, overprice glamour and underprice value; La Porta's analyst-forecast sort shows the high-growth-forecast stocks earn the lowest returns, not a pure risk story.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Value Premium As Expectational Error
